purpose: Third Trial final RGB + MS synthesis
combined_score_method: Mean of normalised RGB score and normalised MS score.
rgb_evidence: Visible emergence and green-cover based indicators.
ms_evidence: Relative image-derived NDVI and NDRE indicators.
day7_policy: Observed Day 7 and adjusted Day 7 values remain separate.
inside_outside_policy: Only Ideal and Moisture treatments are used for fixed Inside/Outside comparison.
interpretation_warning: Combined score is descriptive, not a formal statistical test.
